description: This source file defines the 'LocalSiloDetails' class, which implements the 'ILocalSiloDetails' interface. It encapsulates details about a local silo in an Orleans cluster, such as its name, cluster ID, DNS host name, silo address, and gateway address, with lazy initialization for certain properties.
